**Micah Sierra** "**Katt** " **Williams** (born September 2, 1971) is an American stand-up comedian and actor. He played Money Mike in _[Friday After Next](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Friday_After_Next "Friday After Next")_ , was a recurring cast member on the first four seasons of _[Wild 'n Out](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wild_'n_Out "Wild 'n Out") and_ portrayed Bobby Shaw in _[My Wife and Kids](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/My_Wife_and_Kids "My Wife and Kids")_. Williams also provided the voice of A Pimp Named Slickback in _[The Boondocks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Boondocks_\(2005_TV_series\) "The Boondocks \(2005 TV series\)")_ and Seamus in _[Cats& Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cats_&_Dogs:_The_Revenge_of_Kitty_Galore "Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore")_, and portrayed Lord Have Mercy in _[Norbit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norbit "Norbit")_.
## Early life
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Katt_Williams&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life")]
Micah Williams was born in [Cincinnati, Ohio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cincinnati "Cincinnati"), on September 2, 1971.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-6abc.com-2)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-officialbio-3) He was raised in [Dayton, Ohio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dayton,_Ohio "Dayton, Ohio") by.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-clubshayshay-4)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-officialbio-3) He stated that he learned to read at three years old, and was communicating in multiple languages, including French and [Haitian Creole](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haitian_Creole "Haitian Creole"). During his childhood, he lived in [Haiti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haiti "Haiti") for a year and a half on religious mission trips with his family.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-5)
Williams [emancipated](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emancipation_of_minors "Emancipation of minors") himself from his parents at age 13 and moved to Florida. Though homeless and living in a park, he supported himself as a street vendor.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-6)[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-:0-7) He stated that he wanted to remain God's friend.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-clubshayshay-4)
Since at least 2016, Williams has stated on numerous occasions that he enlisted in the [United States Marine Corps](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Marine_Corps "United States Marine Corps") as a minor at the age of 16, attended boot camp, and was subsequently discharged when his age was discovered. However, in a CBS News investigation, the Marine Corps stated that there was no record of Williams having ever served in the military or attended any Marine training facilities.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-8)
## Career
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Katt_Williams&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Career")]
### Stand-up comedy
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Katt_Williams&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Stand-up comedy")]
Williams started performing comedy in the [Avondale](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avondale,_Cincinnati "Avondale, Cincinnati") neighborhood of Cincinnati.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-Katt_Williams_Biography_1-9)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-Katt_Williams_Biography_2-10) He honed his comic delivery by performing his routine in clubs around the country and had become an established comic by 1999, appearing at the likes of [The Improv](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Improv "The Improv"), The Comedy Club, [The Ice House](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Ice_House_\(comedy_club\) "The Ice House \(comedy club\)"), and [Hollywood Park Casino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollywood_Park_Casino "Hollywood Park Casino"). Most notably, he appeared on [BET](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BET "BET")'s _[ComicView](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ComicView "ComicView")_ as Katt "N da Hatt" Williams.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-Katt_Williams_Biography_1-9)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-Katt_Williams_Biography_2-10)
Williams starred in his first comedy special, _Let a Playa Play_ , in 2006. His first [HBO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HBO "HBO") stand-up special came in 2006 with _The Pimp Chronicles, Pt. 1_.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-Katt_Williams_Biography_1-9) In 2007, he co-wrote and starred as himself in the comedy film _[Katt Williams: American Hustle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams:_American_Hustle "Katt Williams: American Hustle")_. The film had critical success and established Williams as a mainstream comedian.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-Katt_Williams_Biography_1-9)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-LASentinel-11) In 2008, he released his second [HBO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HBO "HBO") comedy special, _[It's Pimpin' Pimpin'](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/It's_Pimpin'_Pimpin' "It's Pimpin' Pimpin'")_.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-12)[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-Sanneh-13) Keeping busy releasing comedy DVDs and touring, Williams had a comedy tour that was named the best of 2008 by _Billboard_.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-Sanneh-13)
After a four-year hiatus, Williams returned to stand-up in 2012 for his third HBO comedy special, _Kattpacalypse_.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-14) Later that year, he ended up in jail after an incident at a [Seattle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seattle "Seattle") bar where he reportedly acted threatening and violent, then resisted arrest. The next day, Williams announced the end of his stand-up comedy career.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-15) However, three days later, he announced he would not retire.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-16)
Two live performances in November 2012 ended early because of Williams' confrontational behavior. A November 1 performance at the [Wells Fargo Theatre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wells_Fargo_Theatre "Wells Fargo Theatre") in [Denver](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Denver "Denver") ended after he jumped off the stage to confront a [heckler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heckler "Heckler").[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-17) Williams' November 16 performance at the [Oracle Arena](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oracle_Arena "Oracle Arena") in [Oakland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oakland "Oakland") ended after he engaged in a profanity-laced confrontation with a heckler, and was assisted off stage by his own security team.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-18)
During late 2013, Williams was on his Growth Spurt Tour.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-19) On August 16, 2014, he returned with a new HBO special titled _Katt Williams: Priceless: Afterlife_ , which was directed by [Spike Lee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spike_Lee "Spike Lee").[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-20)[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-21)
In September 2015, during an interview, Williams announced and described his upcoming Conspiracy Theory Tour: "The [conspiracy conversation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conspiracy_theory "Conspiracy theory") is a conversation that we are all familiar with. We know that there are conspiracies out there, but this is a conversation that encompasses a lot of things that aren't being discussed other places. That's the basis for all conspiracy theories: the fact that there is hidden information out there, and how our process changes about things that we thought we used to know. We all, at some point, if we're are at a certain age, we grew up [thinking Pluto was a planet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pluto#IAU_classification "Pluto"). This is probably going to go down as one of my finest works, just because it's a collection of forbidden topics that we can't seem to get answered. I am one of the rare urban public officials. Part of my guarantee in my ticket price is that I'm going to be talking about what we are talking about now, and discussing from now to the next time we see [me] again. This is the open discussion that we've had since 2003. This is what it is about."[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-22)
In 2018, Williams released a new stand-up special on [Netflix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Netflix "Netflix") called _Great America_ and shot in [Jacksonville, Florida](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jacksonville,_Florida "Jacksonville, Florida").[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-23)
In 2022, Williams released a new stand-up special on Netflix called _World War III_.
In January 2024, Williams was featured on retired NFL player [Shannon Sharpe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shannon_Sharpe "Shannon Sharpe")'s podcast, _[Club Shay Shay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Club_Shay_Shay "Club Shay Shay")_. Williams' comments on the entertainment industry and other comedians including [Cedric the Entertainer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cedric_the_Entertainer "Cedric the Entertainer"), [Steve Harvey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steve_Harvey "Steve Harvey"), and [Rickey Smiley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rickey_Smiley "Rickey Smiley") gained traction on social media.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-24)
On May 4, 2024, _Katt Williams: Woke Foke_ streamed live from Los Angeles. Part of _[Netflix Is a Joke Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Netflix_Is_a_Joke_Festival "Netflix Is a Joke Festival")_ , it was Williams' thirteenth stand-up comedy special (his third for [Netflix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Netflix_original_stand-up_comedy_specials "List of Netflix original stand-up comedy specials")).[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-25)
### Acting
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Katt_Williams&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Acting")]
In 2002, Williams made his acting debut on _[NYPD Blue](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NYPD_Blue "NYPD Blue")_ on the sixth episode of its tenth season on October 29. Williams is best known for his character Money Mike in the film _[Friday After Next](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Friday_After_Next "Friday After Next")_ (2002), and has played supporting characters in _[Norbit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norbit "Norbit")_ (2007) and _[First Sunday](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_Sunday "First Sunday")_ (2008).[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-Katt_Williams_Biography_1-9)
He appeared in the official music video for [Nick Cannon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nick_Cannon "Nick Cannon")'s single "[Gigolo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gigolo_\(Nick_Cannon_song\) "Gigolo \(Nick Cannon song\)")" in 2003. He next appeared as a regular on _[Wild 'n Out](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wild_'n_Out "Wild 'n Out")_ on [MTV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MTV "MTV") during its first three seasons.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-Katt_Williams_Biography_1-9)

## Legal issues
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Katt_Williams&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: Legal issues")]
Williams has faced legal issues throughout his career, including 19 felony charges.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-28) While he has pleaded no contest and has received sentences of probation and fines, he maintains that he has no felony convictions on his record.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-29)
On November 13, 2006, Williams was arrested at [Los Angeles International Airport](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles_International_Airport "Los Angeles International Airport") after a gun that had been reported stolen was found in his briefcase.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-30) On December 14, he pleaded no contest to a misdemeanor count of carrying a concealed firearm and was sentenced to three years' probation, ordered to pay restitution, and given credit for the three days he spent in jail.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-6abc.com-2)
In November 2010, Williams was arrested by police while working on a film in [Coweta County, Georgia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coweta_County,_Georgia "Coweta County, Georgia"). He was accused of stealing $3,500 worth of coins and jewelry. He was released the following day on a $40,000 bond.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-31) Police later charged him with burglary and criminal trespass.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-News_Report-32)
On June 11, 2011, Williams was arrested in connection with an alleged assault on a tractor driver. The alleged victim said three women approached his tractor at around 4:30 p.m. local time and attacked him with rocks and dirt clods, causing him facial injuries.[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-33) [Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles_County_Sheriff's_Department "Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department") officers arrived on the scene and arrested the three women for assault with a deadly weapon, and arrested Williams for felony intimidation of a witness.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-tmztractor-34) He was booked into jail and released that same night on $50,000 bail.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-tmztractor-34)
On November 15, 2012, Williams was arrested in [Oakland, California](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oakland,_California "Oakland, California"), on charges of suspicion of assault with a deadly weapon; he had allegedly beaten an 18-year-old with a bottle aboard Williams' tour bus in [Berkeley, California](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Berkeley,_California "Berkeley, California").[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-St._Clair-35)
An attendee of Williams' shortened performance at the [Oracle Arena](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oracle_Arena "Oracle Arena") in Oakland on November 16, 2012, filed a [class action lawsuit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Class_action_lawsuit "Class action lawsuit") days after the event, seeking compensation for himself and "all others who paid money for a show, but got nothing but Katt Williams' nonperformance".[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-36)
On December 2, 2012, Williams was arrested in [Seattle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seattle "Seattle") after he allegedly got into a dispute at a bar in the [South Lake Union](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Lake_Union,_Seattle "South Lake Union, Seattle") neighborhood. His arrest came after he no-showed the first night of a planned two-night performance at the [Paramount Theatre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paramount_Theatre_\(Seattle\) "Paramount Theatre \(Seattle\)").[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-seattletimes.com-37) Five days later, he was arrested in [Dunnigan, California](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dunnigan,_California "Dunnigan, California"), on a [bench warrant](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arrest_warrant "Arrest warrant") arising from an incident the previous month in [Sacramento, California](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sacramento,_California "Sacramento, California"), during which he allegedly drove a three-wheeled motorbike onto a sidewalk and refused to stop for police. The resulting chase was halted due to safety concerns, and the bench warrant was issued after Williams narrowly missed several bystanders.[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-komonews-38)
On December 28, 2012, Williams was arrested in [Los Angeles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles "Los Angeles") on child endangerment charges. He was held in lieu of $100,000 bail, and four of his adopted children were placed in [protective custody](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protective_custody "Protective custody"). According to reports, the case fell apart and no trial was scheduled.[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-39)[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-40)
On January 8, 2013, Williams was arrested at his Los Angeles home after failing to appear in [Sacramento](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sacramento "Sacramento") to answer the November 25 motorbike charges.[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-41)
On October 29, 2014, Williams and [Suge Knight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suge_Knight "Suge Knight") were arrested for the theft of a camera from a photographer in [Beverly Hills](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beverly_Hills,_California "Beverly Hills, California") on September 5.[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-42) In April 2017, Williams pled no contest to the charge of robbery and was ordered to undertake a year of anger management classes as well as receiving three years' probation.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-43)
On February 29, 2016, Williams was arrested in [Gainesville, Georgia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gainesville,_Georgia "Gainesville, Georgia"), when a clerk at a swimming pool store said Williams had hit him. When police arrived, they found Williams already lying face down with his hands behind his back, waiting to be handcuffed.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-44)
On March 23, 2016, a video went [viral](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viral_video "Viral video") of the 44-year-old Williams getting into a fight with a 17-year-old boy following a dispute during a [soccer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Association_football "Association football") game in Gainesville. The authorities planned to review the incident with the [DA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/District_attorney "District attorney") in addition to his ongoing court cases.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-45)[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-46)
On April 27, 2016, Williams was arrested and charged with battery in [Atlanta, Georgia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atlanta,_Georgia "Atlanta, Georgia"), after allegedly throwing a salt shaker at the manager of a local restaurant. The manager claimed to have been hit in the mouth with the salt shaker when Williams' group was denied preferential seating.[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-47)
On July 24, 2016, Williams was arrested on suspicion of battery after an altercation with a woman at the Sportsman's Lodge, a hotel in [Studio City, California](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Studio_City,_California "Studio City, California").[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-48)
On September 15, 2016, Williams was arrested in [Fulton County, Georgia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fulton_County,_Georgia "Fulton County, Georgia"), on a charge of second-degree criminal damage to property, after having turned himself in on a warrant for failing to appear in court for the April 27 incident. This new arrest involved an allegation from February 28, 2016, stating that Williams had thrown a man's cellphone.[[49]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-AP09-16-16-49)
On October 6, 2018, Williams was arrested in [Portland, Oregon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portland,_Oregon "Portland, Oregon"), on a charge of assault in the fourth degree, after he assaulted a driver during an argument about his dog. He was additionally arrested on an outstanding warrant from Georgia.[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-50)
